name: Muelas de los Caballeros (Spain)
description: White field with a blue triangle from the lower hoist to the middle of the upper edge and a red triangle from the lower hoist to the middle of the fly, charged with a green cypress.
history: The heraldic arms and the flag were officially approved on 23 September 2004 and published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León of 21 October 2004; the flag is rectangular, of proportions 2:3, formed of a blue triangle with its vertices at the lower end of the hoist and the midpoint of the upper edge, a red triangle with its vertices at the lower end of the hoist and the midpoint of the fly, the rest white with a green tree.
